head: 018feca97ad7731d2e27cebf298550cd8ace5610
description: #75's original description, written for this commit, so the metadata check passes.

expected.title: The snapshot pin is midnight, before the publication that triggered it
expected.detail: The transform keeps only the date from the InRelease `Date:` line and appends `T000000Z`, so the proposed snapshot predates (and leaves out) the security publication that caused the bump.

expected.title: No smoke test checks that the image keeps the apt snapshot
expected.detail: `docs/usage/core.md` and ADR 0022 promise that apt in the image and its children keeps reading the pinned snapshot; no `smoke.sh` asserts `APT::Snapshot`.

expected.title: The snapshot datasource reads an unsigned InRelease over plain HTTP
expected.detail: Renovate fetches InRelease over `http://` and reads its `Date:` without a signature check; a forged date becomes an automerged pin.

expected.title: ADR 0022 carries implementation details
expected.detail: ADR 0022 names apt's config file, the `apt-get install` command and the containerd.io revision pin; the repository's AGENTS.md forbids implementation details in an ADR.

expected.title: ADR 0019 misstates the snapshot exemption
expected.detail: ADR 0019 says the snapshot bumps "as soon as the archive changes" and puts it under a lead-in ("registries do not say when a release was published") that does not fit it; the config bumps only in a daily window.
expected.match: as soon as|registries do not say|lead-in

expected.title: Stale pointer in ADR 0022
expected.detail: "(the previous rule, in ADR 0013 and the README)" points at text this same PR removes.
